Guideline: Always use layout managers so the UI resizes correctly
Do: Wrap widgets in QVBoxLayout/QHBoxLayout/QGridLayout; set stretch factors
Don't: Use setGeometry/absolute positioning or fixed pixel sizes
Notes: Absolute coords break on resize, DPI, and translations

Do: Set layout.setSpacing(8) and contentsMargins multiples of 4
Notes: Define spacing tokens once; reuse everywhere

Keywords: hidpi, high dpi, 4k, scaling, blurry, retina
Guideline: Let Qt scale; design in logical points
Do: Use Qt6 automatic HiDPI; ship SVG + @2x icons; size in pt
Don't: Hardcode pixel sizes or disable HiDPI scaling
Notes: Qt6 scales by default; provide setDevicePixelRatio assets

Guideline: Use Layouts for resizable content; anchors for fixed relationships
Don't: Anchor everything manually in complex resizable screens
Notes: Mixing anchors inside a Layout item is an error

Keywords: responsive, resize, min size, breakpoint, adaptive
Guideline: Support resizing and a sensible minimum window size
Do: Set minimumSize; collapse sidebars below a width threshold
Don't: Assume a single fixed window size

Guideline: Avoid nested scrolling that fights the main scroll
Do: One primary scroll area per region; size content to fit
Don't: Nest a QScrollArea inside another scrolling view

Notes: QFormLayout handles label alignment + DPI automatically

Don't: Cram everything into one giant widget
Notes: Dock widgets give users layout flexibility for pro tools

Guideline: Set size policies so the right widgets grow
Do: QSizePolicy Expanding for content, Fixed for chrome
Don't: Leave default policies and fight with spacers
Notes: Stretch factors + size policies replace manual math
